+"""Load inline images and objects from the configured image bucket."""
+
+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _object_key(reference: str) -> str | None:
+    parsed = urlsplit(reference)
+    if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or reference.startswith("//"):
+        base = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+        prefix = base.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+        if (
+            parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https")
+            or parsed.scheme != base.scheme
+            or parsed.netloc.lower() != base.netloc.lower()
+            or not parsed.path.startswith(prefix)
+        ):
+            return None
+        key = unquote(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+    else:
+        key = reference
+        if key != parsed.path:
+            return None
+
+    if (
+        "\\" in key
+        or any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in key)
+        or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/"))
+    ):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(reference: str | None) -> bytes | None:
+    if not reference:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if reference.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, separator, encoded = reference.partition(",")
+            if separator and header.endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+            return None
+
+        key = _object_key(reference)
+        if key:
+            # The storage client supplies the endpoint and bucket.
+            return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", error_type=type(exc).__name__)
+    return None
